decidedBy: Essenthos, 2026-09-28, on the genealogy review's names several men share, each occurrence read against its verse by claude-sonnet-5 and every reading checked against the Hebrew and its parallel lists by claude-opus-5-5, under the project owner's decision of 2026-09-16 that a namesake the text does not identify is a person of his own
policy: A word names the one its verse names. Where the verse, its register or a list it repeats identifies the man, the word is his; where the text gives him a family or an office no held record has, he is written here as a person of his own; where the text leaves two readings open, the word is left unnamed.
